title: Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager
description: Overview FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Department Technical & Infrastructure Location Brazil Position Summary The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager reports to the Dressing and Signage Senior Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women's World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires an outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing & Signage Cluster Manager is responsible for leading the venue branding, look and signage operations and delivery strategy from planning through implementation to closure across all FIFA Official Sites. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of a world‑class dressing and signage project for all target groups attending matches of the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™, ensuring that the look and feel is up to FIFA quality standards. The role assumes event operational proficiency, venue dressing, signage and wayfinding knowledge with project management skills to directly oversee the dressing implementation at four FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ stadia. They will ensure that key project deliverables and deadlines are met within their sites and will be required to input into strategic project decisions taken by senior members of the team. They will oversee contracted provider operations within their sites, ensuring that all are managed successfully and efficiently while monitoring budgetary spending within agreed limits. They will ensure that precedents and strategic directives from the Head of Dressing and Signage and Senior Dressing and Signage Manager are followed as required by the members of the team. The role will collaborate closely with other dressing, signage, wayfinding, and non‑competition managers to maximize creativity and ensure consistency across all stadiums. Key Responsibilities Oversee the turnkey planning of dressing and signage implementation across all official sites during the planning phase, and stadium dressing for 3-5 stadia closer to the tournament. Collaborate with the other Stadium Dressing Managers and ensure that precedents are followed to guarantee consistency across all tournament stadiums. Work closely with the Non‑Competition Dressing Managers and the Wayfinding and Signage Managers as well as other Functional Area Managers, to maximize efficiencies across the wider project. Serve as the focal point for all general stadium dressing questions or requests from the Head of Department. Oversee contracted provider planning, production and implementation for all stadiums within the assigned sites. Constantly monitor the budgetary impact of dressing operations and report updates to the Senior Manager and Head of Department regularly. Provide strategic input into the stadium dressing planning process and offer expertise when required. Adhere to project deadlines and deliverables as instructed by senior members of the department. Maintain daily liaison with other members of the wider Dressing and Signage team to ensure efficient planning and delivery is optimized at all stages of the project. Liaise with stadium owners and operators as required to gain approval on implementation plans. Present to senior team members, management and other FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ functional areas as and when required. Attend department‑specific and organization site visits at assigned stadiums and other stadiums or official sites. Input into the site‑specific dressing strategies utilizing expertise from previous events and directives from management. Act as the main stadium dressing point of contact for Dressing and Signage Venue Managers and other Functional Area Venue Managers within the assigned sites during the implementation phase of the project. Participate in the creative design process for stadiums within the assigned sites. Assist with the recruitment of Dressing and Signage project team members in collaboration with the senior department leads if required. Ensure the needs of internal FIFA functional areas are captured and delivered against within the assigned sites. Contribute to project management and knowledge management initiatives including event debriefs, and knowledge capture and documentation activities. Possibly relocate to a Host City for up to three months to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods. Your Profile Minimum 4+ years of experience delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games, etc., or a minimum 2 years’ experience managing major sports events in a role that included the delivery of comprehensive dressing or signage related activities. A working understanding of the technical aspects of delivering dressing and signage projects (i.e. production methods, installation techniques, materials etc.). Strong understanding of stadium look and feel requirements and large‑scale temporary installations. Budget management experience on complex and multi‑faceted events and projects. Experience managing providers of services for world‑class events. Knowledge of event planning, requirements and event project management processes for large sporting events. Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organizations and departments. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with the ability to assess and implement effective solutions. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in an appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) in Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. Readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs, as the role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems. Will attend site visits and be away from home for periods of time, including on‑site attendance during the tournament period. Right to work in Brazil. Fluent in English (spoken and written). Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written). Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: A CARREIRA DO FARMACÊUTICO DE ASSUNTOS REGULATÓRIOS
description: A carreira farmacêutica especializada em regulação sanitária de indústrias, distribuidoras e empresas do varejo farmacêutico é uma das mais valorizadas pelo mercado de trabalho. Esta carreira possui grande projeção profissional no meio industrial e em órgãos reguladores, em que existe maior complexidade nas atividades realizadas pelo profissional, consequentemente as maiores remunerações estão em localidades que possuem polos industriais farmacêuticos, como São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Goiás, Rio Grande do Sul, Paraná, Brasília e Pernambuco. Ser especialista em regulação sanitária exige do profissional aptidão para tarefas administrativas, conhecimentos aprofundados em legislação sanitária nacional e internacional e capacidade de negociação, liderança, comunicação e gestão. O inglês é indispensável e o espanhol pode ser um diferencial para grandes empresas farmacêuticas brasileiras, que detêm filiais na América Latina. A competição profissional nesta carreira é acirrada, pois a atuação não é restrita ao farmacêutico por força de lei. Dessa forma, o profissional formado em Farmácia compete com praticamente todos os profissionais de saúde, advogados e até administradores de empresas. Responsabilidades na indústria de medicamentos e em consultorias especializadas: Acompanha os processos de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novos produtos; Analisa relatórios de qualificação e validação; Acompanha e avalia o mercado e os lançamentos de novos produtos dos concorrentes; Administra e executa o processo de registro de novos produtos farmacêuticos na Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa); Acompanha diariamente as publicações da Anvisa no Diário Oficial da União (D.O.U.); Discute novas resoluções em Consultas Públicas na Anvisa; Acompanha e implementa novas resoluções e regras sanitárias; Recebe e acompanha auditoria sanitária; Administra o processo de revalidação do registro de produtos; Acompanha o sistema de atendimento ao cliente (SAC) e registros do setor de farmacovigilância; Orienta o departamento de marketing em publicidades e propagandas; Orienta o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Verifica os registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento. Responsabilidades nos órgãos reguladores: Acompanha o cumprimento de normas e legislação por parte das empresas; Propõe e debate com o mercado o desenvolvimento de novas resoluções e regulamentações; Fiscaliza a qualidade e o seguimento de regras na produção de produtos farmacêuticos; Fiscaliza a comercialização de produtos farmacêuticos; Regulamenta o preço dos medicamentos; Regulamenta os tipos de medicamentos e suas formas de comercialização; Regulamenta o comércio farmacêutico e suas características de consumo. Orienta e acompanha o departamento jurídico em demandas de cunho sanitário; Cuida dos registros e cadastros sanitários do estabelecimento; Orienta e fiscaliza condições de estoque e armazenamento de produtos; Acompanha e fiscaliza condições de transporte e distribuição de produtos farmacêuticos. Áreas de atuação: Indústrias farmacêuticas; Empresas de logística farmacêutica; Consultorias especializadas; Vigilância sanitária de estados e municípios (Visa). O curso de graduação em Farmácia é o mais indicado para profissionais que desejam seguir carreira em Assuntos Regulatórios principalmente na indústria de medicamentos. É importante ressaltar que profissionais que desejam atuar em agências reguladoras, como a Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa), é necessária a aprovação em concurso público específico. O curso de graduação em Direito também têm peso e relevância. Uma especialização em Assuntos Regulatórios é obrigatória. Existe também a opção de especialização em Logística Farmacêutica para os profissionais que atuam especificamente em distribuidoras. Para que o profissional se mantenha atualizado é imprescindível que ele acesse, com periodicidade, o conteúdo específico da área farmacêutica publicado no Diário Oficial da União e o site da Anvisa, para manter-se informado sobre novas legislações e consultas públicas vigentes. O ICTQ - Instituto de Pesquisa e Pós-Graduação para o Mercado Farmacêutico tem em seu portal na internet um canal de notícias atualizado diariamente com as novidades demandadas pela Anvisa, vale a pena acompanhá-lo. O mesmo Instituto é pioneiro no Brasil com curso de especialização em Assuntos Regulatórios na Indústria Farmacêutica, além de oferecer a pós graduação em Gestão, Logística e Distribuição Farmacêutica. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Digital Product Manager Department: Commercial & Marketing Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Digital Product Manager will be the driving force behind FIFA’s digital direct-to-consumer experiences for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. Whilst the role will be based in Rio, the successful candidate will act as an integral member of the global Product & Design team, defining fans’ digital journey across FIFA’s owned and operated platforms, notably including FIFA.com and FIFA’s official mobile app. Reporting to Head of Brand & Marketing, the primary responsibility will involve taking the lead in evolving FIFA’s fan-facing websites and apps specifically for FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. This will include developing digital activations that support tournament goals and objectives, as well as delivery of commercial value for FIFA’s partners. With the biggest, most ambitious FIFA Women’s World Cup™ on the horizon, this is your chance to help shape the next generation of digital experiences and grow the Women’s game! KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Strategic Vision: Play a leading role in defining and developing FIFA’s digital consumer-facing proposition, specifically ensuring products and experiences reflect local fan behaviours and consumption habits, as well as aligning cultural nuances and emerging trends across Brazil and South America. Fan Engagement: Support FIFA’s audience growth goals by optimizing acquisition, engagement and retention journeys across owned platforms, as well as contributing to first‑party data strategies. Value Generation: Partner closely with Commercial and Marketing teams to develop scalable digital activations and integrations that deliver measurable value to fans and partners alike. Tournament Planning & Delivery: Become an integral enabler of tournament‑time digital operations, delivering high‑traffic match moments, live content publishing, rapid issue resolution and cross‑functional coordination during competition periods. Collaboration: Operate as an integral member of Digital Delivery, working alongside Product Managers located across Europe and acting as the department’s key representative within FIFA27. Governance & Communication: Provide clear, consistent updates to senior management and key stakeholders. Participation in cross‑functional steering groups to maintain a balance between critical tournament milestones and product scope delivery. Drive Innovation: Champion a consumer‑first mindset; exploring opportunities for innovation and application of AI‑driven solutions to enhance content personalization and discovery, improve operational efficiency and create new fan engagement experiences that resonate with fans globally and locally. Data‑driven Performance: Establish and track key performance indicators, using a blend of behavioural insights and user research to inform product development priorities, optimise product performance and exceed tournament goals and objectives. YOUR PROFILE Education & Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in computer sciences, business management or related discipline Relevant product development philosophies, e.g., Agile, are essential Relevant project management qualifications, e.g., PRINCE2, highly beneficial Work Experience: 5+ years of product management experience, demonstrating end‑to‑end experience across the digital product lifecycle; from UX/UI design and roadmap development to rigorous testing and release management. Experience working in a direct‑to‑consumer business, ideally within sports, media or related industries. Experience leading complex projects will be highly beneficial, demonstrating aptitude for balancing personal development of others with empowerment to “get the job done”. Exceptional communication skills—both written and verbal—to succinctly and confidently interact with a wide range of stakeholders up to and including senior FIFA management. Demonstrable experience working autonomously and/or with ambiguity; with an ability to adapt swiftly to organisational change or leverage short‑term opportunities. Competencies: Confidence leading multiple projects with autonomy, often with colleagues and/or suppliers located in different territories and time zones. Passion for developing consumer experiences and thinking big picture; complemented with a demonstrable understanding of digital product development and design principles. Data‑driven with an aptitude for harnessing data, forming KPIs, and leveraging consumer insights to make informed decisions. Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and cross‑functional teams across FIFA, each with varying degrees of digital maturity and technical understanding. Willingness to travel to other FIFA offices and venues, typically in Zurich, as well as relocating to another location for a period of time, e.g. during FIFA Women’s World Cup in 2027. Languages: Fluent in Portuguese and English. Proficiency in another official FIFA language, such as Spanish, is a benefit. Technology: Strong knowledge of digital direct‑to‑consumer ecosystems, including mobile and video. Solid understanding and passion for digital innovation, including application of AI. Experience with industry‑standard solutions, e.g., Figma, Asana and Confluence. Requirements: Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Brazil - Remote: Senior Backend Engineer (Python)
description: We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. The Opportunity We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges: Ingestion: Handling massive streams of sensor data with minimal latency. Intelligence: Making LLMs deterministic and reliable within robust multi-agent systems. Context: Modeling complex ontologies to map thousands of physical assets. What You’ll Do You will join a high-performance team, contributing to the Core Backend while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks: Core Responsibilities High-Performance APIs: Build low-latency Python services (FastAPI) to serve live data to frontend and AI models. System Reliability: Debug complex concurrency issues and ensure production reliability in distributed systems. Rapid Delivery: Adopt a ‘deliver fast’ mentality without compromising on code quality, testing, or API design standards. Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more): Streaming & High-Throughput Data Build Streaming Pipelines: Design scalable services using Kafka and Spark/Flink to process raw sensor data in real-time. Time-Series Optimization: Optimize database schemas (TimescaleDB) to enable fast historical data retrieval and implement algorithmic checks to validate sensor readings. GenAI & Autonomous Agents Build Autonomous Agents: Deploy stateful agents (using LangGraph) that plan tasks, query Knowledge Graphs, and execute tools without hallucinating. Advanced RAG: Build Graph-RAG pipelines that combine semantic search with structured knowledge traversal for grounded answers Graph & Knowledge Engineering Knowledge Graph Engineering: Design domain ontologies in Neo4j, defining relationships between assets, documents, and time-series data. Search Infrastructure: Implement Hybrid Retrieval logic combining Vector Search, Full-Text Search, and Graph traversal. The Technology Stack We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track. Core Backend: Python 3.12+ (FastAPI, Pydantic), Polars, Docker, Kubernetes. Streaming: Apache Kafka, Flink, Spark Streaming, TimescaleDB, Tiger Data. GenAI: LangGraph, LangChain, LiteLLM, Azure OpenAI/Anthropic/Local SLMs. Graph/Data: Neo4j (Cypher), PostgreSQL (pg_vector, Full-Text Search). Desired Profile Problem Solver: You dig into logs to find the root cause of a data spike, a silent failure, or a disconnected node in a graph. Modern Pythonista: You are up-to-date with modern Python async patterns and typing, ensuring code is high-performance and maintainable. You understand Big O notation and how to optimize code for CPU/memory efficiency. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Must Haves: 5+ years of experience in Python Backend development. Advanced English communication skills. Computer Science fundamentals: Data Structures and Algorithms. Strong experience building and documenting REST APIs (FastAPI). Good to Have: Streaming: Proficiency with Streaming Technologies (Kafka, Flink, Spark) and Time-Series Databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB). GenAI: Practical experience building applications with LLMs, Agentic Frameworks (LangGraph), and Vector Databases. Graph: Hands-on experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j/Cypher), SQL database design, and Hybrid Search strategies Background in Heavy Industry, O&G, or IoT data (MQTT, OPC UA). Experience with Local LLMs (Ollama) for privacy-focused deployments. Familiarity with Data Lineage or Metadata management. Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation. title: Senior Identity Governance Specialist - Bilingual
description: The Purpose We are seeking an experienced Identity Governance Specialist with strong expertise in Saviynt development (coding), platform upgrades, and application onboarding. The ideal candidate will play a key role in supporting Saviynt Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) solutions while ensuring scalability, security, and compliance across the enterprise. The candidate requires a good understanding of identity management as a business risk. Principal Responsibilities Support Saviynt IGA solutions aligned with organizational security and compliance requirements Lead and execute Saviynt platform upgrades, including: Version assessments and upgrade planning Impact analysis and remediation of custom code Post-upgrade validation and issue resolution Develop and maintain Saviynt custom code and configurations, including: REST and out-of-the-box connectors Rules, workflows, and provisioning policies Custom APIs, reports, and integrations Perform application onboarding into Saviynt for on-premises and cloud/SaaS applications, including: Account and entitlement aggregation Access request and approval workflows Automated provisioning and deprovisioning Role and birthright access modeling Implement and support identity lifecycle management (Joiner, Mover, Leaver) processes Configure and manage access certifications, SoD controls, and compliance reporting Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to connectors, workflows, provisioning, and upgrades Collaborate with application owners, infrastructure teams, and security stakeholders during onboarding and upgrades Support environment management across dev/test/prod and participate in release management activities Create and maintain technical documentation (Standard operating procedures, Knowledge base articles), upgrade runbooks, and application onboarding standards Work Model Hybrid (2 days in the office / 3 days from home) in the following cities: Buenos Aires, Salta, Rio de Janeiro, Sao Paulo, Santiago, Bogota, CDMX, and Lima. Remote in all other cities within: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Mexico, and Peru. Requirements Mandatory Requirements (Must-Have) Core IGA & Platform Expertise Experience: 3+ years of hands‑on experience with an Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) solution, preferably Saviynt. Application Onboarding: Demonstrated experience onboarding applications into Saviynt. Lifecycle & Directory Integration: Experience integrating Saviynt with directories and identity sources (e.g., Active Directory, Azure AD, HR systems, ERP, AWS). Upgrades & Maintenance: Proven experience performing IGA platform upgrades and managing version changes. Technical & Development Skills Coding & Scripting: Strong development/coding experience, including Java / Groovy scripting and PowerShell. Integration Mechanisms: Practical experience with REST‑based integrations, ITSM integrations, rules, workflows, and APIs. Problem Solving: Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills. Functional IAM Knowledge Foundational Concepts: Solid understanding of IAM/IGA concepts, specifically identity lifecycle management, RBAC / ABAC, access certifications, and Segregation of Duties (SoD). Language & Communication Language Proficiency: Bilingual capabilities (Español/Ingles or Português/Ingles). Ideal Qualifications (Nice-to-Have) Certifications Product Specific: Saviynt certifications (IGA Professional, Advanced, or Implementation certifications). Industry Standards: CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional), CISM (Certified Information Security Manager), or CGRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance Certification). Cloud & Ecosystem Familiarity Cloud Infrastructure: Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Ecosystem Tools: Familiarity with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow. Complementary Technical Skills Alternative Languages: Background in Python, native Java, REST APIs, or other scripting languages to supplement the core requirements. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Guest Experience Manager
description: Department: Tournament and Venue Operations Location: Brazil FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. The Position The Guest Experience Manager is responsible for the development and implementation of the guest experience concept exclusively within the FIFA VIP Hotel environment, including the FIFA Club. This role focuses on brand implementation, experiential elements, FIFA Club concept (including F&B), and curated guest touchpoints such as gifts and in‑hotel experiences. Key Responsibilities Lead the development and execution of the VIP Guest Experience concept within the FIFA VIP Hotel, including FIFA Club, brand implementation, and experiential elements (e.g. gifts, amenities, and curated guest touchpoints). Define the FIFA Club concept (including F&B, design, and guest journey) and oversee its implementation. Supervise the tender process, evaluation, and appointment of guest experience suppliers related to VIP Hotel and FIFA Club delivery (e.g. experiential agencies, branding, F&B concept providers). Coordinate and maintain a strategic overview of all guest experience activities within the VIP Hotel environment. During tournament time, act as FIFA Club Manager (or oversee FIFA Club Manager role), responsible for operational setup and delivery of the FIFA Club. Collaborate with relevant functional areas to ensure alignment of VIP Hotel guest experience delivery (e.g. Accommodation, Protocol, Transport, Branding). Establish clear lines of communication and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and involved parties. Develop training concepts and deliver training sessions for all relevant suppliers, their service staff, and volunteers, focusing on excellence and ‘wow’ customer service. Attend site visits and inspections. Your Profile Education Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Business Management, Hospitality Management, Event Management, Marketing & Communications, or a related field. Specialization in hospitality, event management, or experience design is an advantage. Experience 5+ years of proven experience in developing and delivering premium VIP guest experience concepts and operations, ideally within hotel environments, hospitality settings, or large‑scale events. Extensive experience in concept development and implementation of guest experience elements, including branding, scenography, F&B concepts, and curated guest touchpoints. Experience in designing and delivering premium hospitality environments (e.g. lounges, clubs, VIP spaces, or hotel‑based experiences). Proven experience in managing and coordinating external agencies and suppliers for experience delivery (e.g. production, branding, F&B, experiential agencies). Hands‑on experience in implementing on‑site guest experience concepts, including setup, testing, and operational delivery. Experience working in cross‑functional environments, coordinating with hospitality, accommodation, and operational stakeholders. Skills & Competencies Fluent Portuguese and English (spoken and written) with excellent communication skills. Strong attention to detail with the ability to ensure high‑quality delivery of premium guest experience standards. Ability to translate conceptual ideas into operational execution, ensuring consistency between design and on‑site delivery. Strong problem‑solving skills with the ability to anticipate, manage, and resolve complex situations in fast‑paced environments. Proven ability to manage and steer multiple external suppliers and agencies to deliver against defined concepts and timelines. Collaborative mindset with strong stakeholder management skills across cross‑functional teams. Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and priorities simultaneously. High level of adaptability and resilience in dynamic, high‑pressure event environments. Solid understanding of premium hospitality environments and guest expectations. Advanced skills in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint; Project or similar tools is an advantage). Certifications & Requirements Project Management certification or equivalent experience is an advantage. Additional certifications in hospitality, event management, or experience design are considered a plus. Right to work in Brazil. Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Essa posição terá papel fundamental no desenho, execução e otimização de experimentos ao longo de todo o funil de marketing e vendas, com o objetivo de acelerar a geração de demanda, otimizar investimentos e escalar a aquisição de clientes. O que buscamos Ensino Superior completo ou em curso em Marketing, Administração, Engenharia de Produção, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Experiência comprovada em Growth Marketing, Mídia Paga (Performance) ou Business Intelligence voltado para marketing. Forte domínio em ferramentas de Web Analytics (Google Analytics 4, Tag Manager) e plataformas de automação/CRM (RD Station, HubSpot, ActiveCampaign ou similares). Mentalidade de cientista: facilidade com números, raciocínio lógico apurado e paixão por rodar testes baseados em dados, não em achismos. Competências-chave Pensamento analítico e tomada de decisão baseada em dados (Data-driven). Foco agressivo em metas, resultados e otimização de performance. Agilidade para planejar, testar, errar rápido e corrigir rotas. Curiosidade intelectual e perfil autodidata para novas ferramentas e canais. Comunicação clara para traduzir dados complexos em planos de ação operacionais. title: ELECTRICAL ENGINEER
description: GA Drilling is developing next-generation drilling technologies to unlock geothermal energy anywhere on Earth. Our mission is to make geothermal a globally scalable, baseload source of clean power by enabling access to hard, hot rock at depths and temperatures that conventional drilling cannot reach economically. Our work demands mastery across electronics, hydraulics, mechanics, systems, control, and project management to create products that survive and perform in harsh, high-temperature, high-load downhole conditions. We are seeking an engineer with 5+ years' experience in power-electronics design, testing, and manufacturing, as well as prototyping, operating, and debugging the associated test equipment. The ideal candidate will be equally well versed in design, analysis, and test. You will be based at our Brazil office in Rio de Janeiro. The opportunity for you You will own the development of power-electronic hardware, analog and digital circuits, and embedded high-voltage systems for our downhole drilling technologies. The role spans schematic design, prototype bring-up, validation testing, and field support — working closely with mechanical, firmware, and systems engineers, and providing direct technical support to operations and drilling crews during testing and deployments. Responsibilities Design & Development Develop power electronic hardware, analog and digital circuits, and embedded high-voltage systems and control applications. Create system block diagrams, schematics, wiring harnesses, and detailed electrical designs using engineering CAD software. Design and implement electrical stress tests (e.g., pressure, temperature, vibration) to ensure product reliability and durability. Look ahead at validation requirements, and develop and execute test plans and setups using both firmware and hardware debugging tools. Testing, Validation & Field Support Conduct prototype board bring-up, functional testing, and performance analysis. Troubleshoot electronic faults at the component and system level using diagnostic tools such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, and spectrum analyzers. Provide technical support to field service technicians and on-site drilling crews to resolve operational problems. Collaborate across mechanical, firmware, systems, and project teams on product development, testing, and failure analysis. Support a positive and proactive HSE culture and ensure that all activities adhere to HSE policy. What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge 5+ years of power electronics engineering experience, ideally within advanced engineering for complex industrial product development environments. Experience with high-voltage transmission and protection, and motor control electronic circuits (motor drivers, position feedback) used in oil & gas drilling, electric actuators, automation systems, electric vehicles, and similar applications. Experience with DC-DC converters (Buck/Boost, Flyback) used in power supplies across industrial and consumer electronics, including permanent downhole installations for oil & gas. Experience with analog and digital filters used across transmission networks, radio, satellite, medical devices, and oil & gas sensors and signal monitoring. Experience with sensors found in industrial and commercial electronics, including permanent downhole installations for oil & gas. Proficiency with electronics simulation and CAD tools used to model, simulate, and design electronic devices. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Strong analytical thinking and ability to read technical documentation, schematics, and engineering specifications. Customer Interface & Cross-Functional Collaboration Experience working directly with operations teams, field service technicians, and on-site drilling crews to support testing, deployments, and resolution of operational problems. Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate field and test observations into clear, actionable engineering feedback. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence Strong attention to detail with a disciplined approach to testing, documentation, and configuration control. Demonstrated ability to work independently, execute project plans from high-level direction, and deliver reliably against schedule and milestones. Experience contributing to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement driven by test and field results. Ability to balance speed and rigor in fast-moving, technically challenging environments. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands-on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable working in the lab, on the shop floor, in test environments, and in the field as required, including occasional travel. Strong safety and quality focus, with respect for procedures while helping evolve them as systems mature. Adaptable, resilient, and effective in early-stage and transitioning-to-commercial technology environments. Ability to provide and receive constructive, technically grounded feedback that improves product performance and reliability. Nice to have BSEE or MSEE preferred. Experience with embedded firmware development for high-voltage or motor control applications. Exposure to oil & gas, drilling, or downhole electronics qualification standards. Interest in geothermal energy, drilling systems, or high-temperature downhole environments. What we offer: Opportunity to develop unique and innovative technological solutions which have the potential to change the world. The satisfaction of solving challenges associated with making ultra-deep geothermal energy a commercial reality. Be part of an experienced, global and highly motivated team. Collaborate with the world’s top industry players. Competitive industry compensation & benefits. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: MECHANICAL TECHNICIAN
description: GA Drilling is developing next-generation drilling technologies to unlock geothermal energy anywhere on Earth. Our mission is to make geothermal a globally scalable, baseload source of clean power by enabling access to hard, hot rock at depths and temperatures that conventional drilling cannot reach economically. Our work demands mastery across electronics, hydraulics, mechanics, systems, and control to create products that survive and perform in harsh, high-temperature, high-load downhole conditions. We are seeking a mechanical technician with 3+ years' experience in lab and field testing of mechanical and electromechanical equipment for downhole drilling systems, including assembly, prototyping, operating, and debugging the associated test equipment. You will be based at our Brazil office in Rio de Janeiro. The opportunity for you You will own the hands‑on assembly, testing, and maintenance of mechanical and electromechanical equipment for our downhole drilling systems — running functional and performance tests in the lab and supporting prototype bring‑up, qualification campaigns, and operational deployments in the field. You will work alongside mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers, capturing test data and feeding it back into design and reliability improvements. Responsibilities Conduct functional tests, performance evaluations, and calibrations on mechanical and electromechanical equipment to ensure compliance with quality standards and manufacturer specifications. Set up and operate test equipment — pressure and temperature test rigs, hydraulic test benches, torque tools, dimensional metrology (calipers, micrometers, dial indicators), and data acquisition systems — to run characterization, qualification, and acceptance testing. Diagnose and repair mechanical and hydraulic failures at the component and assembly level, including disassembly, inspection, replacement of worn or damaged parts, and rework of seals, fasteners, and fittings. Support prototype bring‑up and design iterations by capturing test data, flagging anomalies, and feeding observations back to mechanical and systems engineers. Assembly, Field Support & Documentation Assemble, disassemble, inspect, and perform preventative maintenance on mechanical and hydraulic equipment (downhole tools, actuators, drillstring components, pumps, valves, and associated test fixtures) according to technical specifications and procedures. Maintain accurate service records, calibration logs, and repair documentation, and generate clear reports on work performed and equipment status. Provide hands‑on support to field representatives and drilling crews during qualification campaigns and deployments, and travel to field locations when required. Coordinate with other technicians, engineers, and field representatives to resolve complex issues, support failure analysis, and ensure seamless equipment deployment. Help maintain an organized work environment and manage inventory of electronic components, parts, and supplies. Support a positive and proactive HSE culture, adhere to HSE regulations and quality procedures, and help maintain a safe, organized work environment (5S, housekeeping, waste segregation). What we expect from you Experience & Technical Domain Knowledge 3+ years of experience working with mechanical and hydraulic equipment, preferably in an industrial or oilfield environment. Technical school certificate in mechanical technology, mechatronics, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. Proficiency with mechanical and hydraulic test equipment (pressure and temperature rigs, torque tools, hydraulic benches), dimensional metrology instruments (calipers, micrometers, dial indicators), and hand and power tools. Skilled in mechanical assembly and disassembly, including torque‑controlled fastening, seal and o‑ring installation, and alignment of rotating and reciprocating components. Ability to read, understand, and interpret technical manuals, drawings, schematics, blueprints, and engineering instructions. Experience troubleshooting and repairing mechanical and hydraulic equipment and generating clear service and calibration reports. Ability to work in both Portuguese and English. Basic computer literacy and familiarity with data acquisition and diagnostic software, plus strong problem‑solving, analytical, and critical thinking skills. Customer Interface & Cross‑Functional Collaboration Experience working alongside engineers, field representatives, and drilling crews to support testing, deployments, and on‑site troubleshooting. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to capture lab and field test observations as clear, actionable feedback for engineering. Execution, Testing & Operational Excellence High attention to detail and discipline in service records, calibration logs, and repair documentation. Ability to work independently or as part of a team, executing assigned tasks reliably against schedule and procedures. Contributes to root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement based on test and field results. Ability to balance speed and rigor in fast‑moving, technically challenging environments. Professional Mindset & Working Style Hands‑on, practical mindset with a strong bias toward action and problem solving. Comfortable on the shop floor, in the lab, and at field locations as required, including travel. Strong safety and quality focus, with respect for procedures while helping refine them as systems and processes mature. Adaptable and resilient in early‑stage and transitioning‑to‑commercial technology environments. Open to giving and receiving constructive feedback that improves equipment performance and reliability. Nice to have Associate degree or higher in mechanical technology, mechatronics, or a related discipline. Experience with downhole tools, drillstring components, or other oilfield mechanical equipment. Familiarity with calibration management systems and qualification testing standards. Interest in geothermal energy, drilling systems, or high‑temperature downhole environments. What we offer: Opportunity to develop unique and innovative technological solutions which have the potential to change the world. The satisfaction of solving challenges associated with making ultra‑deep geothermal energy a commercial reality. Be part of an experienced, global and highly motivated team. Collaborate with the world’s top industry players. Competitive industry compensation & benefits. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Supervisor de Documentação (RJ)

title: Integrity Engineer
description: Location :Rio de Janeiro ERP Eligibility: ((cust_erp)) Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliver powerful solutions. Sumary: Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSOunits and associated equipment. As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring that all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector. Key Responsibilities Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up‑to‑date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records. Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively. Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations. Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details. Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modifications schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements. Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety‑critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation. Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance. Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements. Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance. Key Competencies: Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management. Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity. Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality. Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi‑disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment. Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions. Analytical and Problem‑Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions. Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence. Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly. Qualifications and Experience Engineering degreeis mandatory. CREA‑RJ accreditation is required. Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage. Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred. Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable. Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders. Why Join Us? At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment. If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production. If you want to team up with us as we dream and stride towards a better tomorrow – we would love to hear from you! #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Atuar com as rotinas de farmácia hospitalar, recebendo, armazenando, separando e dispensando medicamentos e materiais, sob a supervisão direta do Farmacêutico. Sobre o Hospital Pedro II - CER Santa Cruz Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia. Responsabilidades e atribuições Receber, conferir e armazenar os medicamentos e insumos; Controlar o estoque, distribuir, dispensar e fracionar medicamentos; Realizar a conferência da dispensação de medicamentos e insumos, sob supervisão direta do Farmacêutico; Realizar o controle de temperatura do ambiente e geladeira; Confeccionar etiquetas para unitarização de doses de medicamentos; Separar medicamentos por paciente e/ou setores; Controlar os medicamentos devolvidos; Auxiliar na limpeza e organização do setor; Realizar todas as atividades pertinentes ao cargo, sob supervisão direta do Farmacêutico; Realizar atividades de área/ setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor Imediato e padronizações da Instituição. title: Engenheiro(a) de Software (Full Stack) | IT Pricing Distribution
description: Engenheiro(a) de Software (Full Stack) | IT Pricing Distribution São Paulo ou Rio de Janeiro Por que trabalhar no BTG? Que tal ter a chance de ser dono do seu próprio negócio dentro de uma empresa sólida e com mais de 40 anos de história? No BTG valorizamos espírito empreendedor, autonomia, agilidade, foco no cliente, excelência e visão de longo prazo. Agimos com integridade, responsabilidade, simplicidade, inconformismo e dedicação. Meritocracia está no centro do nosso dia a dia. Temos um escritório open space e uma estrutura horizontal onde você vai conversar com os melhores profissionais de mercado e ter desafios reais e diários. Sobre a área A tecnologia no BTG é um dos principais pilares de transformação e crescimento do banco. Investimos constantemente em inovação, escalabilidade e excelência técnica para suportar um dos maiores ecossistemas financeiros da América Latina. Nossa área é responsável pela captura, consolidação, distribuição e governança do Market Data utilizado em diversas frentes do banco. Realizamos integrações com as mais variadas fontes de mercado, provedores externos e infraestruturas financeiras, garantindo a disponibilidade, qualidade e confiabilidade das informações consumidas por sistemas e áreas de negócio. Atuamos em contato direto com as áreas de negócio para entender demandas, desenvolver novas soluções e evoluir sistemas de missão crítica que servem como base para diversos produtos, plataformas e motores de cálculo dentro do BTG. Buscamos profissionais que queiram participar da evolução da arquitetura de nossos sistemas, contribuindo para soluções de alta performance, resilientes, escaláveis e com grande impacto nos processos e produtos do banco. No seu dia a dia Desenvolver novos produtos e evoluir aplicações críticas com foco em performance, resiliência e escalabilidade; Participar de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento, desde a definição da arquitetura até a implantação em produção; Construir soluções distribuídas baseadas em eventos e mensageria; Atuar em ambiente Cloud AWS; Trabalhar em conjunto com usuários de negócio, equipes de tecnologia e arquitetura corporativa; Monitorar, diagnosticar e evoluir aplicações em produção; Participar de discussões técnicas relacionadas à arquitetura de software, observabilidade e melhores práticas de engenharia. Esperamos de você Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas; Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento backend utilizando .NET (C#); Experiência em desenvolvimento frontend utilizando React e TypeScript; Conhecimento em arquitetura orientada a eventos (Event-Driven Architecture); Experiência prática com plataformas de mensageria como RabbitMQ, Kafka, Amazon SQS ou tecnologias similares; Experiência no desenvolvimento de APIs REST e microsserviços; Conhecimento em testes unitários, testes de integração e automação; Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais, especialmente PostgreSQL e/ou SQL Server; Interesse em construir sistemas de missão crítica com elevados requisitos de disponibilidade, escalabilidade e desempenho. Diferenciais Arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, SOLID, DDD e Microsserviços); Experiência com sistemas distribuídos e processamento assíncrono em larga escala; Conhecimento em padrões como Saga, Outbox, CQRS e Event Sourcing; Observabilidade e monitoramento (Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry e Datadog); Bancos de dados não relacionais (Redis, MongoDB e DynamoDB); Conhecimentos de mercado financeiro, Market Data, precificação de ativos e gestão de risco; Experiência em levantamento de requisitos e interação com usuários de negócio; Afinidade com matemática, estatística ou métodos numéricos; Experiência com ferramentas de IA aplicadas ao desenvolvimento de software (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude ou similares), utilizando-as para aumento de produtividade, automação de tarefas e melhoria da qualidade do código; Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR); Auxílio Alimentação e Refeição; Planos por adesão como Previdência Privada e Seguro de Vida; Desconto em Farmácia; Programa de Nutrição; Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida – empresa Cidadã. O BTG Pactual respeita a pluralidade de identidades e trabalha para promover uma cultura inclusiva. Não fazemos distinção de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade em nenhuma etapa do processo seletivo, reforçando nosso compromisso com a diversidade. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: [AE] ANALISTA DESENVOLVEDOR MOBILE - PLENO
description: Ouvir, criar e inspirar a transformação digital dos nossos clientes é o que nos motiva. De pessoas para pessoas Acreditamos que, mais do que tecnologia, a transformação digital é sobre como as pessoas conduzem as mudanças nas empresas. E por entender isso, o fator humano é o que nos faz evoluir e modernizar processos. Não é somente mais uma oportunidade... e sim um convite para você fazer parte dessa história. Na iblue Consulting você vai trabalhar com uma equipe multidisciplinar, que é responsável por alavancar o crescimento do negócio através das nossas pessoas. Requisitos Estamos em busca de um ANALISTA DESENVOLVEDOR MOBILE PLENO com experiência em projetos complexos e vivência com equipes multidisciplinares, para atuar no desenvolvimento da camada mobile utilizando React Native, garantindo qualidade técnica, aderência à arquitetura definida e integração eficiente com backend, que seja apaixonado por inovação e que esteja comprometido com a entrega de soluções de alta qualidade. Se você tem experiência em metodologias ágeis e se identifica com valores como colaboração e comprometimento, essa oportunidade é para você! Principais Responsabilidades Desenvolver aplicações mobile cross‑platform utilizando React Native; Implementar funcionalidades e fluxos de interface conforme arquitetura definida; Integrar com APIs REST e, quando necessário, WebSockets; Trabalhar com navegação (React Navigation ou similar); Implementar gerenciamento de estado (Redux, Zustand ou Context API); Aplicar padrões de código e boas práticas definidos pela liderança técnica; Participar de code reviews; Corrigir bugs e evoluir funcionalidades existentes; Garantir consumo adequado de APIs e tratamento de erros. Contexto Técnico de Atuação no Projeto Atuará em uma arquitetura composta por: App Mobile (React Native + Expo); Backend/BFF em Java (Spring Boot); Integração com múltiplos microsserviços; APIs documentadas via OpenAPI/Swagger. Fluxos com: Autenticação complexa (token/sessão); Eventos de analytics; Notificações push; Consumo de dados em tempo real. Requisitos e Qualificações 3+ anos de experiência em desenvolvimento mobile; Experiência com React Native; Experiência com Expo (build e configuração); Experiência com TypeScript; Experiência com consumo de APIs REST; Conhecimento em WebSockets; Experiência com gerenciamento de estado (Redux, Zustand ou Context API); Conhecimento em navegação (React Navigation ou similar); Experiência com Git; Familiaridade com pipelines de CI/CD. Habilidades Comportamentais Organização e disciplina técnica; Capacidade de aprendizado contínuo; Boa comunicação com equipe técnica; Colaboração em equipe; Comprometimento com qualidade de entrega. Diferenciais Conhecimento em otimização de performance mobile; Experiência com animações (Reanimated, Lottie); Experiência com testes (Jest, Testing Library); Experiência com publicação em stores; Conhecimento básico em segurança mobile. Benefícios Pacotes de benefícios oferecidos pela cooperativa que você poderá escolher de acordo com a sua necessidade; Descanso remunerado de 15 dias, após 12º mês. Notebook de última geração; Bônus por indicação de candidatos. Treinamentos na iblue Academy; Treinamento na Udemy; Certificações (AWS, Microsoft, IBM e H20). #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Líder de Projetos de Subsuperfície de Pesquisa e Tecnologia
description: Empresa empregadora TotalEnergies EP Brasil Ltda Domínio Pesquisa, Inovação e Desenvolvimento Tipo de contrato Contrato Duração Indeterminada (CDI) Experiência Mínimo 10 anos Context & Environment Manter total conformidade com os procedimentos da TotalEnergies e alinhamento com seus interesses e visão de longo prazo. Respeitar orçamentos e cronogramas, garantindo a eficiência de custos, bem como auditar e analisar eventuais desvios ou não conformidades. Representar a filial perante parceiros externos e organizações empresariais, sempre em alinhamento e respeitando os valores e a estratégia da TTE. Atividades Como Líder de Projetos de Subsuperfície de Pesquisa e Tecnologia, o(a) colaborador(a) deverá desempenhar suas atividades em conformidade com o Sistema de Gestão de HSE, alinhado aos Princípios One Maestro e orientado à proteção da integridade das pessoas, considerando a preservação do meio ambiente e dos recursos, por meio da contribuição para a melhoria da eficiência energética e a descarbonização dos ativos e da reputação da Companhia. Coordenar e direcionar programas de P&D relacionados a tecnologias selecionadas pela sede da TotalEnergies e pela TEPBR para apoiar as necessidades de Exploração & Produção. Essas tecnologias abrangem todos os domínios de Geociências — Geofísica, Geologia e Reservatórios — tanto para Óleo & Gás quanto para aplicações de Transição Energética, principalmente reservatórios para armazenamento de CO₂; Atuar como ponto focal técnico da afiliada para temas de geociências relacionados a CCS, assegurando a integração entre as disciplinas de Geologia, Geofísica e Reservatórios; Revisar, desafiar e validar os principais entregáveis técnicos relacionados a estudos e projetos pilotos de CCS, além de oferecer expertise e suporte às equipes de ativos, garantindo robustez e consistência dos estudos de subsuperfície em CCS; Assegurar interação eficaz com a rede global de P&D da TotalEnergies, incluindo participação em atividades de avaliação e qualificação, mantendo forte alinhamento com as equipes e programas OneTech P&D / TL / SRTP; Liderar programas de P&D em Geociências para CCS: identificar, propor e direcionar projetos de P&D voltados a desafios de subsuperfície em CCS, além de gerenciar sua execução, assegurando qualidade técnica, relevância, alinhamento com as prioridades do negócio e transferência eficaz dos resultados para as equipes operacionais. Manter forte interação com OneTech P&D, Houston CDR e parceiros de pesquisa, garantindo alinhamento com os programas globais de tecnologia; Atuar em interface com SGIs, Ativos e Parceiros, em estreita coordenação com Geologia, Geofísica e Reservatórios, assegurando alinhamento com o referencial técnico da Companhia e as melhores práticas. Apoiar equipes de ativos na integração de CCS nas avaliações de subsuperfície e estudos de desenvolvimento, contribuindo para posicionamentos técnicos alinhados com parceiros (ex.: Petrobras) em temas relacionados a CCS; Identificar, propor e desenvolver colaborações e projetos de P&D com universidades, laboratórios, institutos de pesquisa e fornecedores, garantindo forte alinhamento com as prioridades estratégicas da TotalEnergies. Inclui prospecção e maturação de conceitos inovadores voltados aos desafios futuros do negócio, com foco na implementação de pilotos estratégicos; Justificar e apoiar a submissão de novas propostas de projetos, além de avaliar anualmente os projetos em andamento quanto à continuidade de financiamento, com base no conteúdo técnico, qualidade das entregas e alinhamento com os objetivos de P&D. Contribuir para a preparação orçamentária e para o desenvolvimento de dossiês de financiamento (ex.: EMBRAPII); Gerenciar a execução de projetos operados, assegurando entregas no prazo, dentro dos orçamentos aprovados e com comunicação eficaz dos resultados aos stakeholders relevantes. Produzir relatórios de P&D de alta qualidade, incluindo sumários de reuniões, sínteses de conferências, notas técnicas, propostas de trabalho e planos de execução de projetos; Manter colaboração proativa e construtiva com a Petrobras em todas as atividades relacionadas ao STCA, incluindo novas iniciativas, projetos de P&D e trocas de conhecimento; Monitorar o desenvolvimento tecnológico externo proveniente de concorrentes, fornecedores e academia, garantindo que a liderança de P&D da TotalEnergies esteja informada sobre sua relevância e impacto potencial. Acompanhar tecnologias emergentes de geociências aplicadas a CCS, avaliar sua aplicabilidade ao portfólio TEP-Brasil e promover sua avaliação e implementação por meio de projetos de P&D ou pilotos; Compartilhar conhecimento e desenvolver competências: contribuir para o desenvolvimento das capacidades em geociências para CCS na afiliada. Apoiar treinamentos, disseminação de conhecimento e melhores práticas, além de facilitar a comunicação entre P&D, ativos e comunidades técnicas. Responsabilidades Manter total conformidade com os procedimentos da TTE e alinhamento com seus interesses e visão de longo prazo; Garantir a execução dos projetos conforme validado pela Diretoria de P&D e pelas principais partes interessadas; Assegurar a conformidade dos projetos com a regulamentação de P&D da ANP. Perfil do Candidato Formação: Doutorado (preferencial) ou Mestrado em Geologia, Geofísica ou em área correlata de Geociências. Experiência profissional: Experiência em P&D em E&P e/ou Gestão de Projetos, com foco em atividades de Geociências. Considerando que a posição abrange Geofísica, Geologia e Reservatórios, é essencial experiência prévia em equipes de Geociências de Exploração ou de Ativos, bem como em temas relacionados à transição energética, como CCS. Capacidade analítica comprovada, aliada a excelentes habilidades interpessoais, de comunicação (oral e escrita), organização e apresentação. Alinhamento com os valores da Companhia. Informações Adicionais #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description: About the Company: At Playlist, life's richest moments happen when people step away from screens to move, connect, explore, and play. We're building the definitive platform for intentional living, connecting people with inspiring experiences in fitness, wellness, and beyond. With popular brands like Mindbody and ClassPass, Playlist empowers businesses and individuals, making it effortless for aspirations to become actions. Join us in reshaping technology's role to foster meaningful, real‑world connections. Lifecycle Marketing Manager (Leads & Reactivation) As the Lifecycle Marketing Manager (Leads & Reactivation), you will develop and execute lifecycle programs that bring lapsed and churned users back into the experience and help convert new leads through owned channels including email, push, in‑app, and SMS. Reactivation will be the primary focus of this role, with an emphasis on understanding user behavior, identifying growth opportunities, and turning insights into high‑impact campaigns. You'll work hands‑on in Braze and in‑house tools while partnering closely with Product, Creative, Analytics, and Finance to shape programs that improve reactivation, lead conversion, and engagement. This role is ideal for someone who can move confidently between strategy and execution, bring structure to complex work, and use data to form a clear point of view. Own the strategy and roadmap for reactivating lapsed and churned users and converting new leads through lifecycle channels including email, push, in‑app, and SMS Analyze engagement, cohort, and customer behavior data to uncover drivers of reactivation, lead conversion, and churn recovery Build and manage the experimentation roadmap across messaging, incentives, audiences, channel mix, and timing Launch and scale lifecycle campaigns from ideation through rollout using Braze and in‑house tools Design, run, and analyze A/B tests that improve KPIs such as reactivation rate, lead‑to‑activation rate, and engagement Map consumer flows, identify friction points, and recommend scalable solutions or short‑term testing opportunities – define lifecycle KPIs, maintain reporting, and share clear insights, forecasts, variance explanations, and recommendations with stakeholders Partner with Creative, Product, Analytics, and FP&A to align lifecycle priorities and drive high‑impact growth initiatives Experience You Bring 3+ years of experience in growth marketing, lifecycle or CRM marketing, consulting, analytics, or a data‑driven marketing role Hands‑on experience with user acquisition or growth marketing, including lead generation, conversion, and paid or owned acquisition channels Experience owning lifecycle programs from strategy through execution, measurement, and optimization Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into actionable insights, testing plans, and business recommendations Experience designing testing strategies, running A/B tests, and using results to improve campaign performance Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple programs and campaigns with minimal oversight Strong Excel skills and working knowledge of basic SQL for self‑serve data pulls Familiarity with Braze or a comparable email or lifecycle service provider, and experience using project management software such as Asana or JIRA The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We highly value diversity at our company and encourage people of all different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or other protected characteristics. description: Our ideal candidate independently performs installation and commissioning work; coordinates the work activities with other stakeholders at the customer site along with the Service Coordination and Scheduling team. Executes installation and commissioning activities on customer locations for services according to the agreements, within budget and in line with our business objectives on ethics, quality, health, safety, and environment. You will contribute to Americas Operations Teams by delivering top level service on time and with our First Time Right processes. The role sits within Deepsea Operations team and reports to the Team Lead of Technical Services. Who we are Radio Holland is dedicated to pushing the boundaries of maritime technology, offering solutions that enhance the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of global shipping. As the first choice for NavCom solutions, we are committed to delivering reliable, cutting-edge navigation and communication technologies that empower vessels worldwide. With a focus on innovation and quality, Radio Holland continues to lead the industry in developing next-generation navigation systems and integrated bridge solutions, supporting maritime professionals in their mission to achieve safe and seamless operations at sea. Workplace type: Onsite with extensive travel Job Type: Full Time Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil What You Will Do You will: Perform installation and commissioning works on yards, ships and other maritime installations Install and commission maritime navigation, communication and automation equipment based on designs and technical drawings Ensure optimal work preparation to verify that all necessary information on work and scope is available before commencement of work Ensure that all required materials and tools are both present and ready for use, and manage the materials required in the execution of the project work Ensure that the work performed is within the agreed contract scope; ensure that all agreed conditions are met before the work starts. Report deviations to the project manager Ensure that all works can be executed in a safe and responsible manner; stop all works if not the case What Does Success Look Like? Success in the Service Engineer role is a result of compliance to procedures and repeatable successful delivery of service. Over the first 6 months, the Team Lead of Technical Services ensures you have the mentorship, training and certifications to have a long successful career in this industry. Radio Holland stands apart from the other service providers as uniquely skilled in various manufacturers products and services, and your position on this team allows professional skillsets to be grown to support the Americas Operations. Deliver Results A person is successful in this role when they: Check and test the operation of the delivered equipment based on the specified quality and functional requirements in the (technical) order and project data, drawings, inspection plans, scripts and test protocols Develop the skills to correct abnormalities and malfunctions across multiple OEMs and product lines Hand over the commissioned equipment to the client, record the customers approval and possible comments Record as-built changes in the documentation package, hand-over documents and warranty certificates Report on hours spent, progress, issues, deviations in work or scope, and safety concerns to the project manager and engineer to ensure accurate invoicing and documented trail of compliance Give user training on the delivered equipment. (when part of scope) Values and Behaviours Trust to act You take ownership, make informed decisions and follow through on commitments. Passionate to perform You bring energy, aim for high standards and look for ways to improve how work gets done. Make it fun You contribute to a positive working environment, build constructive relationships and collaborate with others in a way that creates energy. Act responsibly You make fair, ethical and sustainable choices, consider the impact of your actions and contribute to an inclusive and respectful workplace. What You Bring Willingness to grow and adapt to the ever changing workplace is essential to our success. Working as a team player, first and the mentee but soon as a mentor for your certifications onto your peers. Required Valid Driver’s License Electrical Experience Strong organizational and communication skills with English Fluency Preferred Obtained a Federal Communications Commission (FCC) or General Operator Certificate (GOC) licensing Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience in Engineering or relevant technical degree CAD experience #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description: Senior Machine Learning Engineer – Teya Senior Machine Learning Engineer you will build models and decision systems that turn Teya's data into better outcomes for our customers and our business. You will work in the AI Research & Development team partnering with engineers, product managers, and domain experts to take problems from framing through model development and into reliable, monitored production systems. Responsibilities Frame ambiguous business problems as well-posed modeling, inference, or optimization tasks, and choose methods that fit the data and the decision. Design, build, validate, and deploy predictive and decisioning models across areas such as fraud and risk monitoring, customer onboarding and due diligence, pricing, and customer lifetime value. Run rigorous experiments and causal analyses, including A/B testing, uplift modeling, and offline evaluation, to measure whether models actually move the outcomes that matter. Engineer features and build the data pipelines that feed training and serving, with attention to leakage, reproducibility, and data quality. Productionise models with strong attention to validation, backtesting, monitoring, drift detection, and retraining, so performance holds up after launch. Work closely with product managers, engineers, and domain experts to identify where modeling creates value and to integrate models into products and operational workflows. Apply optimization and operations research methods where decisions, not just predictions, are the goal. Contribute to modeling standards, evaluation practices, and reusable tooling across the team. Stay current with developments in machine learning and statistics, and apply new methods where they earn their place. Requirements Strong foundations in statistics and machine learning, with the judgment to match methods to problems. Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Strong customer focus and ability to build and maintain relationships. WE VALUE Strong leadership and mentoring skills. title: Workforce Training Manager
description: Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Department: Workforce, People & Culture Location: Brazil Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION Reporting to the Senior Manager Workforce Operations, the Workforce Training Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Workforce Management team, and work in close collaboration with operational delivery Functional Areas within FIFA27, as well as People & Culture in FIFA Zurich, and other key individuals responsible for delivering a cohesive, consistent, and operationally appropriate training programme for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Training Coordination and Project Management Develop and implement a comprehensive training plan that aligns with tournament deliverables/objectives and Functional Area requirements. Coordinate with department heads, trainers/training providers, and other stakeholders to assess and define the training needs strategy. Establish a coordinated and integrated training journey for the tournament workforce, across multiple client groups from planning and development to execution and evaluation. In collaboration with FA Leads training delivery mechanisms for whole client group training sessions and support/provide guidance to Functional Areas on appropriate training schedules, venues, and resources to ensure timely and effective delivery of training programs. Ensure training programs are consistent, culturally appropriate, and tailored to meet the specific needs of different regions. Manage the creation and distribution of template training materials, including accessibility considerations such as multiple languages. Track and report on the progress of training initiatives, managing any changes, delays, or risks. Ensure alignment with the event's objectives, ensuring that efficient and effective training delivery supports the overall success of the Tournament being delivered. Stakeholder Management Collaborate with internal teams (Workforce, Planning & Integration, Volunteer Management, HR, Operations, Security, Technology, etc.), external vendors, and consultants to facilitate consistent training delivery. Serve as the primary point of contact for all organization-wide training-related planning, inquiries and concerns. Regularly communicate with leadership to provide updates on the progress of training initiatives and address any challenges. Monitoring and Evaluation In collaboration with the Senior Manager Workforce Operations, oversee budget requirements for organizational training initiatives, ensuring efficiencies are kept at front of mind. Work in close collaboration with Planning & Integration to create tools that support the effective evaluation of training programs through feedback, assessments, and performance metrics. Adjust training plans and methods based on feedback from trainees and trainers to ensure continuous improvement from one Tournament to the next. Prepare detailed reports on training outcomes, including participant performance, satisfaction, and areas for improvement. YOUR PROFILE Education Bachelor’s degree or equivalent level of education. Experience Solid experience designing and delivering Training/Learning and Development programmes in a fast-paced environment. Demonstrated experience of utilising strong organizational skills and attention to detail to switch from strategic to detailed planning. Significant experience designing and delivering Training/L&D programmes within the Sporting Industry/large-scale events. Certifications & Requirements Right to work in Brazil Fluent in English (spoken and written) Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written) Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr
